bluesparrowtech.com/travel/london-summit-hotels

new_web_content.title: London AI Summit Hotels – Curated Shortlist
new_web_content.text:
London AI Summit Hotels – Curated Shortlist

Riverside View – guest reviews consistently mention stunning River Thames views, making this the top pick.
Cozy Stay – convenient but no reviews mention river views.
Mom's Home – family-run; a couple of reviews note a partial Thames glimpse from upper floors.
London Luxury – central, with mentions of city skyline but none specifically of the River Thames.
Covent Garden Retreat – charming, but guest feedback doesn't mention river views.
